mission: V1-003 — mission lease substrate (cg_mission_lease, cg_worker_delegation_grant, cg_worker_quarantine)
status: APPLIED to canonical 2026-10-03 (checksummed apply via scripts/apply-canonical-hardening.mjs, migration 20261003000019); zero-policy deny-by-default by design
consumer: RLS isolation battery steward (scripts/verify-rls-isolation-battery.mjs registry merge) — extends the zero-policy stage with these tables
authority: AGENTS.md §13 multi-tenancy (every request must have tenant context)
AGENTS.md §17 RLS mandatory; application code is never the only security layer
AGENTS.md §27/§28 service role reserved for trusted server/control-plane operations; append-only ledgers

tables.name: cg_mission_lease
tables.rationale: lease bookkeeping is execution-state coordination, never a client-consumable row set: the workforce host adapter reaches it exclusively through the service-role client (the same posture as the kernel substrate families), tenant scoping is enforced in the adapter via the composite (tenant_id, execution_id, mission_id) FK into cg_execution_record plus per-operation tenant predicates; zero policies keeps deny-by-default strongest form — anon/authenticated are fully revoked (no table privilege), so even a policy accident exposes nothing

tables.name: cg_worker_delegation_grant
tables.rationale: the live revocation surface over the append-only cg_worker_delegation history; delegation grants are authority data (Invariant 12: agent authority flows only through explicit delegation) and must never be readable or writable by client roles — consumed exclusively through the service-role worker-registry adapter which resolves grants into neutral-RBAC extraPermissions at the gate; zero policies + full client revoke is the strongest form

tables.name: cg_worker_quarantine
tables.rationale: quarantine ledger for failing workers (§45 bounded self-healing); append-only governance record consumed only by the control-plane adapter under the service role; zero policies + full client revoke keeps the deny-by-default invariant
